# Second chapter

## A heading marking [Beta]{.index}

A mark inside a heading has its anchor relocated to just after the heading,
so nothing lands in the copy Quarto puts in the table of contents.

The shared term picks up its second locator here: [Shared Term]{.index}.

A mark carrying an id of the author's own keeps it as the link target:
[Gamma]{.index #gamma-anchor}.

A two-level entry, so the level structure is exercised across the store:
[Kappa]{.index entry="Kappa!Sub Level"}.
